resources.string: No UPI app found. Install Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm or BHIM.
Your buffer for this payment needs your fingerprint.

Pauses a PhonePe or Google Pay payment before you tap Pay when it is unusual for you: someone new, much more than usual, or at an odd hour. Reads only UPI apps\' pay screens and, if you switch on the message guard in Orb, the WhatsApp message you are typing (never stored). Orb has no internet access, so nothing it reads leaves your phone.
